title: Bouquet
author: Sutanuka Ghosh Roy
text:
Book launch
Sheaffar pen
hurried autographs,
thunderous applause.
Folded hands
cherubic smile.

On the table
old friend`s old notebook.
nervous sweaty fingers,
tucked it tight
in the chest of drawers.
The bouquet of red roses
on the mantle piece
rounded its lips,
sarky smile.
